name: Desert Soul Inspired by Ombre Nomade | Dark Oud Unisex Perfume
description: Desert Soul, inspired by the luxurious Louis Vuitton Ombre Nomade, is a powerful and captivating unisex fragrance crafted for lovers of deep Arabic oud scents. The fragrance opens with a bold hit of raspberry and spicy nuances, creating a sweet yet smoky introduction. As the scent evolves, rich agarwood (oud) takes center stage, blended with leather and dark rose to form a smooth, intense Middle Eastern heart. The base features birch tar, woody resins, and amber-like warmth, delivering exceptional depth, richness, and long-lasting performance. With its premium perfume-oil concentration, Desert Soul offers exceptional longevity and strong projection—making it ideal for winter nights, gatherings, weddings, and signature oud lovers. Dark, exotic, and unforgettable, this fragrance encapsulates the spirit of the desert and brings the iconic Ombre Nomade experience at an accessible price—exclusive at Scents by Aamir. Features Top Notes: Raspberry, Spicy Accords Heart Notes: Oud, Leather, Rose Base Notes: Birch Tar, Woody Resins, Amber Notes Longevity: 12+ hours (Extremely Long-Lasting) Occasion: Best for nights, winter, weddings, and Arabic gatherings Why Choose Desert Soul? Inspired by the iconic Louis Vuitton Ombre Nomade Strong, dark oud with fruity and smoky depth Premium oil concentration for bold projection Exclusive Arabic-style luxury fragrance by Scents by Aamir
story: Desert Soul, inspired by Ombre Nomade, blends raspberry, oud, leather, and smoky birch tar to create a powerful, long-lasting unisex Arabic fragrance perfect for nights and special events.
